Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.config.dpi

Class PhysicalResolutionCapture

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.config.dpi.PhysicalResolutionCapture
public class PhysicalResolutionCapture extends Object
Provides methods to capture at physical resolution even when DPI awareness is enabled.

This is a workaround for when DPI awareness cannot be disabled at JVM startup.

Since:
1.1.0
